mainEntity.name: How quickly will my matched accountant contact me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Once you complete the 60-second questionnaire, your details are reviewed straight away to find the best match. A qualified local firm will typically contact you within 2 hours to discuss your needs.

mainEntity.name: Are the accountants in your network registered and qualified?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every firm in our network is thoroughly vetted. They are fully qualified Registered Tax Agents, CPAs, or Chartered Accountants — all registered with the Tax Practitioners Board (TPB) and operating in compliance with Australian Tax Office (ATO) standards.

mainEntity.name: Is there any cost or obligation to use the matching service?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Our matching service is 100% free with zero obligation. You can speak with your matched accountant, review their initial offer, and decide if you want to proceed — no pressure, no hidden fees.

mainEntity.name: Can I get help with both personal tax returns and business accounting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. Whether you need an individual tax return, sole trader bookkeeping, company tax structuring, or SMSF advice, we match you with specialists suited to your exact service requirements.

mainEntity.name: What if I prefer online or phone service instead of visiting an office?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many firms in our network offer fully digital cloud services via Xero, MYOB, and phone or video consultations. You can specify whether you prefer in-person meetings or online service during your questionnaire — whichever suits your schedule.

mainEntity.name: How does the matching process work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Answer a few quick questions about what you need help with and where you are. We use your answers to identify the best-suited qualified firm in our network for your area and needs, and your enquiry is sent to that one accountant partner. It takes about 60 seconds and is completely free.

mainEntity.name: What if I'm not happy with my matched accountant?

acceptedAnswer.text: You are under no obligation to proceed. If the first match isn't the right fit, let us know and we will connect you with another vetted firm from our network whose services better align with your needs. The matching service is always free.

mainEntity.name: Do you cover regional areas or only capital cities?

acceptedAnswer.text: We match across Australia — capital cities, regional centres and rural towns. Our network includes firms in every state and territory. Enter your postcode in the questionnaire and we will identify a vetted accountant whose services fit your area, whether you are in a capital city or a regional community.
